title: Mechanic-ec
description: A mod that adds three skill lines: Fisherman, Lumberjack, and Miner. Currently, each skill has one ability (you can level up all skill lines at once, not just one).
body:
This mod addes 3 branches, each has 4 tiers. Lumber, miner and fisher. Every tier gives you buffs and abilities. To unlock higher tiers do missions.

Features this mod provides give you higher mobility and easier farming.  Look in the Quests book mod provides you.

Choose beetwen easy, medium and hard difficulties of mod. You can choose english or russian launguages.

More content will be provided in further versions.
